bullets.text: iPhone 17 Pro Max Dominates - **Apple**'s latest model outperforms **Samsung** in battery life tests, lasting 13 hours.
Nvidia's Bold Investment - **Nvidia** plans a $500 million investment in **Wayve**, a UK self-driving tech startup.
Octopus Energy Spins Off Kraken - **Octopus Energy** announces a spinoff of its **Kraken** platform, eyeing a $15 billion IPO.
Liquid Glass Design Unveiled - **Apple** introduces a new Liquid Glass design language with iOS 26, enhancing app aesthetics.
Tim Cook at Windsor Banquet - **Apple** CEO joins high-profile guests at a state dinner, emphasizing US-UK relations.
iOS 26 Battery Features - New battery settings in **iOS 26** help users manage and prevent excessive iPhone drain.
Apple Watch Hypertension Alerts - **Apple Watch** models gain new hypertension notifications in **watchOS 26**, enhancing health monitoring.
Phia Raises $8M in Seed Funding - Fashion app **Phia**, co-founded by Phoebe Gates, secures $8 million to enhance online shopping.
TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 Approaches - Last chance to secure tickets for **TechCrunch Disrupt 2025**, featuring top tech leaders.
